verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a cloud sandbox platform with an SDK and CLI, but nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Sandbox metrics (CPU, memory, disk) are a feature, not tracking controls. Self-hosting is a deployment option, not a documented opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
